meta.note: One run per method (rep 0). cg = correct-and-grounded rate (balanced over the authorized and unauthorized decidable cases); unsupported_rate = share of undecidable cases that received authorized or unauthorized. Every terminal status (including invalid outputs and method errors) stays in the denominators. method_minus_C: paired difference to the selected CETA specification of the same model and application, with 95% intervals from a paired bootstrap clustered by base event (10,000 draws, seed 20261020). On Indico the strongest agent is G1.
